recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current source satisfies the issue, and changing wording solely to mirror the original requested prose would be redundant after later $translate documentation refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-22636 was a Published/Persuasive R5 vocab issue asking to change the ConceptMap $translate output parameter match.equivalence to match.relationship and update the documentation from ConceptMapEquivalence to ConceptMapRelationship after the FHIR-22632 ConceptMap relationship changes.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been pre-applied. Commit 049b740c24b9a670f52f04286093e41bc6f2d74d changed the $translate response example from equivalence to relationship during the early ConceptMap relationship transition, and commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 introduced the current OperationDefinition XML with match.relationship and ConceptMapRelationship documentation.
additional_context: FHIR-22632 is the prerequisite ConceptMap relationship-change issue. Confluence block-vote material grouped FHIR-22636 as a simple issue related to FHIR-22632 and FHIR-22666. FHIR-22666 concerns neighboring $translate source/target input parameter text and is already represented on the combined branch, so it was not decided again here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini, the build-scoped source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml defines output match.relationship with ConceptMapRelationship documentation, and source/conceptmap/$translate-response.txt examples use relationship output parts. Searches of the ConceptMap operation scope found no remaining stale match.equivalence or ConceptMapEquivalence text.

related_jiras.note: Prerequisite ConceptMap relationship rename and value set replacement that made the $translate output change necessary.
Neighboring $translate input parameter documentation issue grouped with FHIR-22636; already audited separately on the combined branch.
